===
Real-world: Function with runs on and verdict handling
===
function f_send_and_expect(in integer p_value, in float p_timeout := 5.0) runs on CT return boolean {
  var default v_def := activate(a_default());
  p.send(p_value);
  t.start(p_timeout);
  alt {
    [] p.receive(integer:p_value) {
      t.stop;
      deactivate(v_def);
      return true;
    }
    [] t.timeout {
      setverdict(fail, "no response");
      deactivate(v_def);
      return false;
    }
  }
}
---

===

  var PTC_CT v_ptc := PTC_CT.create("ptc") alive;

  all component.done;
